dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: What a bunch of slowpokes... I wrote to the Akademiya to request an archaeological team forever ago.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: As expected, they've made absolutely no progress. I haven't seen a single person from that team.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmures
dialogues.text: In Natlan, where you stumble upon a Saurian relic every three steps and a Saurian ruin every ten, a delay of even a single day is a huge loss!
